scope: Functional-equivalent Vue3/TypeScript/Vite/ElementPlus/Pinia/Axios/ECharts migration, synthetic Mock backend/map retained. Includes targeted risk corrections, adapting the existing 69 E2E cases and 214 textual requirement mappings. Does not include complete production OpenAPI semantics, real backend/algorithms/services, OpenLayers integration or absent PDF screenshot reconstruction.
assumptions: Experienced Vue3/TypeScript developer(s), full-time allocation, existing requirements/layout unchanged.
Shared UI and data-access foundations are implemented before feature pages; page estimates do not include those shared foundations again.
Existing source, fixtures, algorithms and test scenarios are available for reuse after validation, with no promised percentage of code reuse.
One person-day is 8 hours of engineering effort including checks within that work package, not a measured delivery rate. Pilot has not been implemented.
